facts.fact: Yes: the face-authentication Digital Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) needs only a smartphone, so it can be generated at home
facts.quote: The Government of India has launched the Face Authentication Technique based DLC which requires only a smartphone for generation of DLCs.
facts.note: Derived: the page says the face-authentication DLC needs only a smartphone; fact 2 says anyone can operate the app for the pensioner.

facts.fact: Anyone, such as a family member, can operate the Jeevan Pramaan app for the pensioner; the pensioner can also be the operator
facts.quote: Any person can act as an operator. The pensioner can also act as an operator.

facts.fact: India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) also generates the DLC at the doorstep through the postman/Gramin Dak Sevak, on request at the nearest post office
facts.quote: To avail DLC service, a customer can contact the nearest post office or place a request for a doorstep visit by the postman/Grameen Dak Sevak.

facts.fact: During the November DLC campaigns, doorstep service is provided for aged, sick, incapacitated and Divyang pensioners
facts.quote: During the DLC campaigns, provision is made for doorstep service to aged, sick, incapacitated and Divyang pensioners also.

behaviour: Answers with compassion and gives the doorstep options as per sources (Jeevan Pramaan face-authentication app used at home, IPPB doorstep DLC through the postman), citing jeevanpramaan.gov.in / ippbonline.bank.in.
fail_if: It says the pensioner must visit the bank or office in person, or invents a doorstep service, fee or helpline not on an official page.
summary: Added: face-auth DLC needs only a smartphone (PIB, 2 Apr 2026), anyone can operate the app (Jeevan Pramaan manual), IPPB doorstep DLC, and campaign doorstep service for aged/sick pensioners.
